items.title: Document the three determinism guardrails and the back-compat rules
items.context: Guardrails: audit-only finding fields excluded from gates; finding-signals read via stable finding accessor (store.readFindings) not raw findings.json; hints excluded from reviewer promptHash domain. Back-compat: dismissReasonType optional; flat underscore command names.
